conventions.az_el: STARSS23 labels: azimuth 0 deg ahead and positive to the left, elevation positive up
conventions.truth_deg: a pair's lateral angle to the source; + = it reaches the pair's second capsule first
conventions.sphere_ref_deg: what GccPhat reads for that direction through the sphere alone; judge reads against it, not truth_deg (results/starss23/report.md s2)
conventions.dim: brief 11 rule: dim when the top two shares differ by < 0.203, or the read sits within 10 deg of a pause read of share >= 0.5
conventions.range_rel: provisional: 10^((cdr_anchor - cdr)/20), anchored on the first lone speech onset; brief 20 settles the rule
